signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the username and password given to you by your school administrator.

home.title: Your exams
home.empty: You have no exams yet. Choose “New exam” to set one up.

exam.title: Title
exam.subject: Subject
exam.showScheme: Show the mark scheme to students
exam.showSchemeHelp: When on, printed scripts list the mark scheme points a student missed (“Missing:”), and review offers “Suggest from the mark scheme”. Your own comments always print.

newExam.title: New exam
newExam.noClasses: You have no classes yet. Ask your school administrator to create a class and assign it to you.

editor.title: Questions and mark scheme
editor.label: Question label
editor.pointsTotal: Points add up to {{total}} of {{max}} marks
editor.beforeReady: Complete these before marking the exam as ready:
editor.nowReady: The exam is ready. Cover sheets come next.
editor.confirmDelete: Delete this exam and its mark scheme? This cannot be undone.
editor.lockedHelp: The mark scheme can only be changed while the exam is a draft.

import.title: Import from a CSV file
import.help: One row per mark scheme point. Repeat the question columns on every row of the same question. Separate alternative answers with |. The first row must be:
import.problems: The file could not be imported:
import.summary: Found {{questions}} questions worth {{marks}} marks in total.
import.replaceWarning: This replaces the questions in the editor. Nothing is saved until you choose “Save mark scheme”.

users.title: Staff accounts
users.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes. Not case-sensitive.

students.privacyNote: Students are identified by their code on cover sheets and to the AI. Names are optional and stay on this computer.
students.empty: No students in this class yet.
students.name: Name
students.namesHint: Leave empty to add students by code only.
students.countHint: Used only when no names are entered.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

network.unreachable: The Marking Assistant server cannot be reached. Check that it is running on this computer or the school network.

server.error: The server had a problem. Please try again.

errors.not_found: This item does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.conflict: This change conflicts with the current state. Reload the page and try again.

auth.invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
auth.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes, or ask your administrator to reset your password.
auth.csrf_failed: Your session could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.

user.last_admin: The school must keep at least one active administrator.
user.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.

class.duplicate: A class with this name already exists for that academic year.
class.teacher_invalid: Choose an active staff member as the teacher.

exam.subject_unknown: This subject is not available for your school's curriculum.
exam.locked: This exam can no longer be changed.
exam.not_draft: This can only be done while the exam is a draft.
exam.not_ready: The mark scheme is not complete yet.
exam.invalid_transition: The exam cannot move to that status now.
exam.has_scripts: Scans have been uploaded for this exam, so it can no longer return to draft.
exam.sheets_need_ready: Mark the exam as ready first.
exam.pages_not_checked: Check page orientation first: look at every page and confirm they are upright.

mark_scheme.invalid: The mark scheme has errors. Fix them and save again.

request.invalid: Some information is missing or not valid.

upload.not_pdf: This file is not a PDF.
upload.too_large: The file is too large. Scan in smaller batches.
upload.duplicate_file: This exact file was already uploaded for this exam.
upload.not_failed: Only failed uploads can be tried again.
upload.pdf_unreadable: The PDF could not be opened. It may be damaged or password-protected. Scan it again.
upload.render_timeout: The PDF took too long to process. Try scanning in smaller batches.
upload.render_crashed: The PDF could not be processed. Try again, or scan it again.
upload.too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages. Scan in smaller batches.
upload.processing_error: Something went wrong while processing this file. Try again.

page.already_assigned: Some pages are already in a script. Return them to the tray first.
page.not_in_script: This page is not part of a script.
page.not_auto_rotated: This page was not turned automatically.

script.locked: This script is already being marked; its pages cannot change.
script.confirmed: This script is confirmed. Reopen it to make changes.
script.not_ready: The AI has not finished with this script yet.
script.incomplete: Give every point a mark and a category before confirming.

ai.no_scripts: No scripts have been uploaded for this exam yet.
ai.in_progress: The AI is still working on this script.
ai.nothing_to_rerun: There are no unconfirmed scripts to re-run.

decision.marks_out_of_range: Marks must be a whole number from 0 to the point's maximum.
decision.no_proposal: The AI made no proposal for this point.

comment.too_long: Comments can be at most 300 characters.

export.not_confirmed: Only confirmed scripts can be exported.
export.nothing_confirmed: There are no confirmed scripts to export yet.

export.not_ready: The file is not ready yet.
export.failed: The file could not be prepared. Try again.

issues.unknown: There is a problem with this information.

exam.too_many_questions: An exam can have at most {{max}} questions.
exam.subject_unknown: Choose a subject from the list.

question.label_required: Every question needs a label, for example 1(a).
question.label_too_long: Question labels can be at most {{max}} characters.
question.label_duplicate: Label “{{label}}” is already used by question {{first}}.
question.max_marks_invalid: Maximum marks must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
question.too_many_points: A question can have at most {{max}} mark scheme points.
question.no_points: Question {{label}} needs at least one mark scheme point.
question.points_below_max: Question {{label}}: points add up to {{points_total}}, less than the maximum of {{max_marks}}. Full marks would be impossible.
question.points_exceed_max: Question {{label}}: points add up to {{points_total}}, more than the maximum of {{max_marks}}. That is fine for “any {{max_marks}}” questions; marks will be capped at {{max_marks}}.

point.marks_invalid: Point marks must be a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
point.description_required: Every mark scheme point needs a description.

class.teacher_invalid: Choose an active staff member as the teacher.

import.too_large: The file is larger than {{max_kb}} KB.

import.too_many_rows: The file has more than {{max}} rows.
import.row_extra_cells: Row {{row}} has more cells than there are columns.
import.max_marks_not_number: Row {{row}}: question maximum marks must be a whole number.
import.point_marks_not_number: Row {{row}}: point marks must be a whole number.
import.question_not_contiguous: Row {{row}}: the rows for question {{label}} must be next to each other.
import.question_inconsistent: Row {{row}}: question {{label}} has a different text or maximum than on row {{first_row}}.
import.malformed_csv: The file is not a valid CSV file.
import.empty: The file contains no mark scheme rows.

script.point_undecided: A mark scheme point has no final mark or category yet.

decision.marks_out_of_range: Marks must be a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.

comment.too_long: Comments can be at most {{max}} characters.

sheets.needReady: Mark the exam as ready (after completing the mark scheme) before printing cover sheets or uploading scans.
sheets.noStudents: This class has no students yet. Ask your administrator to add them.
sheets.help: Print one cover sheet per student. Each student puts their sheet on top of their answer pages. After the exam, scan the whole stack in order.
sheets.privacy: Cover sheets show student codes only, never names. Use this list to hand out the sheets.

scans.uploadHelp: Choose one or more PDF files from the school scanner. Scan each class stack in order, cover sheets on top. Processing continues in the background.
scans.trayHelp: These pages could not be placed automatically. Check each one, then assign it to a student or discard it. Selecting a cover sheet also selects the pages that follow it.

reason.before_first_cover: Comes before the first cover sheet in the file.
reason.follows_unassigned_cover: Follows a cover sheet that could not be placed.
reason.qr_damaged: Cover sheet with a damaged QR code.
reason.qr_unreadable: Cover sheet found but code unreadable.
reason.qr_conflict: Two different QR codes on one page.
reason.qr_not_ours: Cover sheet with a QR code that was not made by this system.
reason.qr_bad_checksum: QR code read incorrectly (failed its check).
reason.unknown_sheet: Cover sheet not known to this installation.
reason.duplicate_in_upload: The same cover sheet appears twice in this file.
reason.already_uploaded: This student already has pages from an earlier upload.
reason.returned_by_teacher: Returned to the tray by a teacher.

pageFlag.no_answer_pages: Check: only a cover sheet, no answer pages.
pageFlag.more_than_usual: Check: more pages than usual (typical: {{typical}}). Another student's pages may have been added.
pageFlag.fewer_than_usual: Check: fewer pages than usual (typical: {{typical}}). Some pages may be missing.

ai.title: AI marking
ai.help: The AI transcribes each answer page and proposes marks with evidence. It runs in the background (often overnight). Nothing is final until a teacher confirms it.
ai.progress: Waiting: {{waiting}} · AI marked: {{marked}} · Need manual marking: {{flagged}}
ai.failedJobs: {{count}} tasks failed after several attempts. Check the warnings above, then start AI marking again to retry.
ai.workerOffline: The background worker is not running, so nothing will be processed. Restart the Marking Assistant.
ai.modelServerDown: The AI model server (Ollama) cannot be reached. Marking will start when it is back.
ai.modelMissing: The AI model {{model}} is not installed on the model server.

manualReason.unknown: The AI could not process this script.

ai.reader_invalid_output: The AI could not produce a valid transcription.
ai.marker_invalid_output: The AI could not propose valid marks for some questions.
ai.no_answer_pages: This script has no answer pages.
ai.reader_timeout: The AI took too long on a page (it did not finish within the time limit).

queue.title: Marking queue
queue.help: Scripts that most need your attention come first: manual marking, unclear transcriptions, then the lowest AI confidence. Confirmed scripts are at the end.
queue.empty: No scripts yet. Upload scans first.

pageFlag.no_answer_pages: Only a cover sheet, no answer pages

queue.noReviewTime: Average review time will appear here once scripts are confirmed.
queue.localOnly: Review times are stored only in this Margin installation's database and are never sent anywhere else.

review.shortcutsHelp: Shortcuts do nothing while you are typing in a text box. Press Esc to leave the box.
review.reopened: Script reopened. Confirm it again when you are done.
review.cannotConfirm: Give every point a mark and a category before confirming.
review.notReady: The AI has not finished with this script yet. You can look, but not change anything.
review.lockedNotice: This script is confirmed. Reopen it to make changes.
review.markedOnEarlierText: The transcription was changed after the AI proposed its marks: the proposals were made on the earlier text.
review.marksTooHigh: This point is worth at most {{max}}.
review.noProposal: The AI made no proposal for this point. Enter the marks yourself.
review.noProposalShort: No AI proposal: enter the marks yourself.
review.noDeductions: The AI did not deduct marks anywhere on this script.
review.deductedTitle_one: The AI gave {{count}} mark fewer than this point is worth
review.deductedTitle_other: The AI gave {{count}} marks fewer than this point is worth
review.commentHint: At most 300 characters. Saved when you leave the box.
review.transcriptionSaved: Transcription saved as a new version. Earlier versions are kept.
review.editHint: Ctrl+Enter saves. Esc leaves the box without saving.

viewer.autoRotatedHelp: The AI judged this page was not upright and turned it {{degrees}}° (confidence {{confidence}}%).
viewer.rotatedAfterTranscription: This page was turned after it was transcribed. The transcription may be poor.
viewer.reread: Ask the AI to read it again
viewer.rereadQueued: The page will be read again in the background.
viewer.rereadPending: The AI will read this page again shortly.

keys.deduction: Next point where the AI deducted marks
keys.marks: Give the focused point that many marks
keys.accept: Accept the AI's proposal for the focused point
keys.category: Change the category of the focused point
keys.comment: Write a comment on the current question
keys.edit: Edit the transcription of the page shown

results.title: Class results
results.notIncluded_one: {{count}} script is not confirmed yet: it is shown without marks and is not included in any export.
results.notIncluded_other: {{count}} scripts are not confirmed yet: they are shown without marks and are not included in any export.
results.exportsHelp: Only confirmed scripts are exported. Marked PDFs show student codes only, never names.
results.nothingToExport: Confirm at least one script to export results.
results.classPdf: Prepare marked PDFs for the class (one file for printing)

trainingData.title: Models and training data
trainingData.configHelp: Models are changed in the installation's configuration file, not here.
trainingData.exportHelp: Exports confirmed scripts of students whose training consent is recorded: page images, the final transcriptions, and the teacher's marks next to the AI's proposals. Students appear by code only.
trainingData.noConfirmed: No exam has confirmed scripts yet.
trainingData.privacy: Every export is recorded in the audit log. Check the files before sharing them outside the school: a student may have written a name on an answer page.

testModel.short: Test model: not real AI marking
testModel.script: This script was read or marked by the test model, which does not read handwriting. Its transcriptions and proposed marks are not real AI marking. Re-run AI marking with the real model before reviewing.
testModel.scripts_one: {{count}} script was read or marked by the test model, which does not read handwriting. Re-run AI marking with the real model before reviewing.
testModel.scripts_other: {{count}} scripts were read or marked by the test model, which does not read handwriting. Re-run AI marking with the real model before reviewing.

rerun.scriptQuestion: Read and mark this script again? Your decisions on the current proposals are kept as history, and you review the new proposals.
rerun.scriptStarted: AI marking started again for this script.
rerun.examQuestion: Read and mark every unconfirmed script again? Confirmed scripts are not changed. Earlier results are kept as history.
rerun.examStarted_one: AI marking started again for {{count}} script.
rerun.examStarted_other: AI marking started again for {{count}} scripts.

pageCheck.title: Step 1: check page orientation
pageCheck.help_one: Look at the page below and turn it if it is not upright. The AI cannot tell which way up a page is, and an upside-down page can cost the student marks.
pageCheck.help_other: Look at all {{count}} pages below and turn any that are not upright. The AI cannot tell which way up a page is, and an upside-down page can cost the student marks.
pageCheck.confirm: All pages are upright: pages checked
pageCheck.firstNotice: Check page orientation first: AI marking can start once every page is upright.

progress.title: AI marking in progress
progress.finishedCounts: Ready to review: {{ready}} · Need manual marking: {{manual}}

redPen.notPlaced: The red pen could not be placed on this page: its marks are printed in the margin.
